# BrowseHeader

The title row above any browsable list, with a sort icon and a filter icon instead of rows of filter chips.

`TVTracker.BrowseHeader` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<TVTracker.BrowseHeader />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="TVTracker.BrowseHeader"></x-import>
```

## Props (BrowseHeaderProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | Section title, e.g. "Browse All Movies". |
| `level` | `1 \| 2` | 1 renders an h1; default h2. |
| `sortOptions` | `string[]` | Sort choices; the first is the default. Opens from the sort icon as a small menu. |
| `sort` | `string` |  |
| `sections` | `BrowseSection[]` | Filter groups shown in the sheet from the filter icon. |
| `summary` | `string` | Overrides the auto summary line ("Popular · Drama, Thriller"). |
| `placement` | `"bottom" \| "anchored"` | bottom (default): sheet slides up from the bottom of the screen. anchored: sheet drops below the header (for tall design frames). |
| `onChange` | `(state: { sort: string; values: Record<string, string \| string[]> }) => void` | Fires when the sort changes or the sheet is applied. |

### BrowseSection

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` * | `string` |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  |
| `kind` * | `"single" \| "multi"` | single: one choice (segmented bar; the first option means "no filter"). multi: any number (checklist). |
| `options` * | `string[]` |  |
| `value` | `string \| string[]` |  |
